text:
Asha: Starting the sales & partnerships Q&A from today’s all-hands. Drop clarifying questions on pipeline, GTM, or partner asks and we’ll answer live.
Tom (Head of GTM): I’ll handle GTM pipeline questions.
Priya (Sales Ops): Quick one - can someone confirm the FY Q2 net new ARR number we used on slide 7? Need to lock for regional decks.
Asha: FY Q2 net new ARR target = $4.2M. I’ll attach the updated slide after this thread.
Ben (Partnerships): For the next 90 days, should partnerships prioritize cloud marketplace listings or direct channel reseller deals?
Tom (Head of GTM): Sequence: focus first 30 days on marketplace listings (AWS/GCP) to improve discoverability, then shift to a few high-impact direct channel reseller tests over 60-90 days.
Priya (Sales Ops): For forecasting models, what conversion rates should managers use for SQL -> Demo -> Pilot -> Closed?
Asha: Use these as guidance: SQL->Demo 45%, Demo->Pilot 28%, Pilot->Closed 35% (aspirational, based on top reps).
Emma (Product): For enterprise pilots, should Eng guarantee dedicated demo GPUs or will pilots run on hosted with burst credits?
Tom (Head of GTM): Enterprise/strategic pilots get 2 dedicated demo GPUs for the pilot. Smaller pilots use hosted plus burst capacity.
Ben (Partnerships): Co-sell economics question: referral credit vs. margin split? How are we structuring integration support?
Asha: Start with referral credits + integration co-fund. Pilot: 15% referral credit + up to $30k integration co-fund for strategic partners; we’ll measure ROI post-Q2.
Priya (Sales Ops): Who owns the partner onboarding checklist so Sales Ops can add it to the GTM playbook?
Ben (Partnerships): I’ll own the checklist and run a weekly sync with Sales Ops.
DevBot: Partnerships onboarding doc updated: https://internal.redwood/gtm/partnerships/onboarding
Tom (Head of GTM): Action: I’ll update pipeline slides with Asha’s target and conversion rates by EOD. @Priya please produce region-level variance analysis tomorrow.
Priya (Sales Ops): Will do. I’ll share region variance and top 15 accounts driving delta by 12:00 tomorrow.
Emma (Product): Product ask: partner-facing API keys and a usage dashboard by mid-Q2 to speed integrations. I’ll post acceptance criteria here.
Asha: Agree. Product + Partnerships coordinate on requirements and telemetry. Emma, share acceptance criteria and metrics.
Ben (Partnerships): Sales, please map accounts where partners already have relationships. SalesOps, can you provide an import template?
Priya (Sales Ops): Template: CSV columns = partner_name, partner_contact, account_name, account_owner, existing_relationship_notes.
Tom (Head of GTM): Exec request: any blockers to expand Dedicated pilot capacity next month?
Emma (Product): Blocking item = automation for ephemeral pilot nodes. It’s in Eng backlog; I’ll escalate.
Asha: If Engineering needs exec intervention, post a clear ask + ETA in this thread. We want <2 week runway on that ticket.
Ben (Partnerships): I’ll align partner product contacts so pilots can start when capacity is ready.
Tom (Head of GTM): Target window for partner-led pilot kickoffs: May 10-24. Flag unmet dependencies here ASAP.
Priya (Sales Ops): APAC scheduling flagged - need local demo owners. Looping @Sara for AM coverage.
Asha: Thanks all. I’ll publish the slide update + a short follow-up doc after this thread. :thumbsup:
Ben (Partnerships): Thanks team :raised_hands: I’ll send onboarding draft by Thurs EOD.
DevBot: Thread labeled follow-up and assigned to Ben, Priya, Tom.
